description: TS-to-Chart predictor (flow-matching MLP on numbers, one model per dataset), K=32 candidates; the selector is initialized from the FNSPID selector (seed 0) and fine-tuned on this dataset alone. Steps marked 'common' are shared by all Time-MMD datasets. Five seeds are trained (seed 0 has no tag suffix, seed s the suffix _s<s>); the reported number is the mean over the three seeds with the lowest validation target (val_best in results/<tag>.json).

default_setting.note: One default setting on every dataset (appendix): the selector on the pool tmmdC_<dataset> built by predictor_default + pool_default
default_setting.cmd: python -m visor.selector --data tmmd --train "sel_dump/tmmdC_Traffic_tr.npz" --val "sel_dump/tmmdC_Traffic_va.npz" --test "te=sel_dump/tmmdC_Traffic_te.npz" --hist 24 --obj reg --prior 1 --yshare 1 --k_eval 32 --k 16 --mode line --img 224x112 --bs 8 --lora_vision 1 --aux 0.5 --steps 600 --eval_every 100 --val_rows 43 --test_rows 95 --text news --w_shape 0.1 --aux_news 2 --load selector_runs/vt_3b_w_shape0.1.pt --tag tmmdC_ftCPpri_Traffic{sfx} --seed {seed}

steps.name: side_file
steps.note: once for all Time-MMD datasets: writes sel_dump/tmmd_side.npz (history and text of every window, read by the selector) and sel_dump/tmmd_{tr,va,te}.npz (row index used by the baselines)

steps.name: pretraining_windows
steps.cmd: python scripts/data/make_stock_windows.py --freq M --cutoff 2010-10-31 --tag M2010 && python scripts/data/make_stock_windows.py --freq M --cutoff 2002-05-31 --tag M2002 && python scripts/data/make_stock_windows.py --freq W --cutoff 2015-10-23 --tag W2015
steps.note: price windows for --pre auto (weekly datasets W2015, Social Good M2002, the rest M2010), dated before each dataset's validation period

steps.name: pool_default
steps.cmd: python -m visor.pools slice tmmdQ_w512 Traffic tmmdC

steps.name: pool_temperature
steps.cmd: python -m visor.temperature tmmd Traffic 1.0 0.6 --src tmmdQ_w512 --prefix tmmdC

steps.name: selector
steps.cmd: python -m visor.selector --data tmmd --train "sel_dump/tmmdC_T0.6_Traffic_tr.npz" --val "sel_dump/tmmdC_T0.6_Traffic_va.npz" --test "te=sel_dump/tmmdC_T0.6_Traffic_te.npz" --hist 24 --obj reg --prior 1 --yshare 1 --k_eval 32 --k 16 --mode line --img 224x112 --bs 8 --lora_vision 1 --aux 0.5 --steps 600 --eval_every 100 --val_rows 43 --test_rows 95 --text news --w_shape 0.1 --aux_news 2 --load selector_runs/vt_3b_w_shape0.1.pt --tag tmmdC_T0.6_ftCPpri_Traffic{sfx} --seed {seed}
